facts.fact: The Herald reports the ICT Minister saying at a POTRAZ planning workshop in Mutare that Government has developed a new National ICT Policy replacing the outdated 2016 policy; the article gives no adoption or launch date, so the event is dated to the workshop week, early October 2023.
